verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own docs describe issuing unnamed cards in batches ("lotes"), which is a first-party bulk operation, but it covers only card issuance and the evidence shows no bulk API endpoints or batch tooling for other resources. Merchant or category blocking is a related control, not a bulk operation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints across resources (users, cards, transactions, accounts), batch update/delete semantics, limits and error handling for bulk jobs, AI/MCP-driven bulk workflows, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
